h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bathinda

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bathinda

c: Bathinda, in the Malwa region of Punjab, has some of the hottest and dustiest summers in the state and cold winters to match. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bathinda to refinery and power-plant townships, cantonment areas, schools, colleges and municipal parks. Our Fun Fitness machines are made at our factory in Vasai, about 1,220 km away, and delivered by road for installation.

Heat and dust are what wear outdoor equipment down here. Dust gets into joints and bearings, and summer sun fades colours. Galvanised frames resist corrosion, and roto-moulded plastic parts hold their colour better than painted steel. The rest is routine care: wipe the machines every week or two in the dusty months and report stiff joints early. Township and colony parks usually have the space for a larger open gym. Plan it near trees or a shade structure, because summer users come only in the early morning and after sunset.

items.q: How do we keep outdoor gym machines working in Bathinda's dust?
items.a: Wipe them down regularly in the dusty months and keep moving joints clean. Report stiffness to our after-sales team early. Springs and bearings carry a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

items.q: Can you supply a refinery or power-plant township?
items.a: Yes. Share the site plan and expected number of users. We send a layout drawing and quote, manufacture at our Vasai factory and install with our team or a dealer.
In Bathinda's summer, yes. Machines in full sun get hot by mid-morning. Trees or a shade structure keep the gym usable for longer each day.
